title: GBrain Memory Layer for OpenClaw and Hermes Agents
summary: GBrain is an open-source persistent memory substrate that combines Git-managed Markdown repositories with PostgreSQL/pgvector databases. It provides AI agents with a long-term, compounding knowledge base and hybrid search capabilities.
research_notes: Created by Garry Tan to solve AI agent statelessness; emphasizes high data density through structured metadata and Git-versioned knowledge storage.

evolution.summary: GBrain evolved rapidly after its April 2026 launch, introducing an autonomous 'Dream Cycle' for background memory maintenance and deduplication. It now incorporates BrainBench-Real for retrieval evaluation and serves as the primary memory runtime for the OpenClaw and Hermes agent architectures.
